caption: A hand mirror in a sunny doorway is tilted, sending a patch of sunlight dancing across the shaded room.

sa.check: A hand mirror is in a doorway.
A patch of sunlight dances across the room.
The doorway is sunny and the room is shaded.
The tilt comes first and the patch moves with it.

pc.expect: The bright patch moves as the mirror tilts and vanishes when the mirror is turned from the sun.
pc.fail: It stays still while the mirror tilts; or it remains with the mirror turned away; or it is there with no sun on the mirror.

pc.expect: The patch does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It dances with the mirror still; or it moves before the tilt; or it flickers with the mirror steady.

pc.expect: The patch moves in the direction opposite to the tilt, as a reflected beam does.
pc.fail: It moves the same way as the tilt; or it jumps; or it moves crosswise.

pc.expect: The patch is one bright shape roughly the mirror's outline.
pc.fail: It splits into several; or it is a sharp geometric shape unlike the mirror; or it floods the whole room.
A second patch appears; or the mirror duplicates; or the patch becomes solid; or the hand passes through the mirror.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The room and the mirror stay the same.
pc.fail: The room rearranges; or the mirror changes; or the walls change colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
